description: Ex 43-15575, DT-971, VH-REY, PK-REY. Formerly the Broome Tourism Centre painted in old MacRobertson Miller red and black colours as VN-BME; acquired by the failed West Australian Museum of Aviation and stored at Jandakot, sold in 2003 and moved to Amelup on 1-2 September 2012 to be restored as an attraction and guest accommodation outside the Lily Dutch windmill complex.
